title: frangula californica subsp. crassifolia
intro: Frangula californica subsp. crassifolia, commonly known as California buckthorn or lance-leaf buckthorn, is a shrub or small tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of supporting liver and gallbladder function, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Frangula californica subsp. crassifolia include its ability to act as a cholagogue, stimulating the secretion of bile and promoting digestion, as well as its laxative and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, such as emodin and aloe-emodin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
